tools.name: validate_personnummer
tools.description: Validate a Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer (format, Luhn checksum, birth date, age, gender). Checks format only; does not prove the person exists.

tools.name: validate_orgnr
tools.description: Validate a Swedish organisationsnummer (or SE...01 VAT number); returns legal form hint and the derived Swedish VAT number.

tools.name: validate_bankgiro
tools.description: Validate and format a Swedish bankgiro number.

tools.name: validate_plusgiro
tools.description: Validate and format a Swedish plusgiro number.

tools.name: validate_ocr
tools.description: Validate a Swedish OCR payment reference (Luhn check digit, optional length digit).

tools.name: generate_ocr
tools.description: Generate a Swedish OCR reference (check digit, optional length digit) from a base number such as an invoice number.

tools.name: swedish_account_to_iban
tools.description: Validate a Swedish national bank account (clearing + account number, Bankgirot checksum rules) and convert it to IBAN using the official Bankinfrastruktur clearing table. Returns bank, BIC, account type, IBAN.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate any IBAN (ISO 13616 mod-97 + country length) and identify the bank for Swedish IBANs.

tools.name: lookup_clearing_number
tools.description: Look up bank name, BIC, IBAN id and account type for a Swedish clearing number.

tools.name: swedish_holidays
tools.description: List Swedish public holidays, eves and observances for a year (computed).

tools.name: swedish_date_info
tools.description: Weekday (sv/en), ISO week, holiday names and business-day status for a date. mode=bank treats midsommarafton, julafton and nyårsafton as non-business days.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Add (or subtract) business days to a date using Swedish holidays (e.g. payment due dates).

tools.name: count_business_days
tools.description: Count Swedish business days after "from" up to and including "to".
